factoryProxy.note: PERMANENT, user-facing. This is the address the SDK and every integration uses. It does not change across factory-logic upgrades.

factoryLogic.note: UUPS implementation behind factoryProxy. Never addressed directly.

walletImplementation.note: Clone template. Every wallet is a minimal clone of this with 40 bytes of immutable args (owner 0-19, factory 20-39).

ucep.note: The security boundary. Sole action policy on every mandate; stripping it fails closed.

sessionValidator.note: Stateless. Its address is an input to every permission id, so this deployment is pinned for the life of the environment - replacing it invalidates every existing mandate.

sessionEngine.note: Vendored fork 7dc20e4, adopted unmodified. Installed as each wallet's only validator module.

adminState.note: Admin is the deployer EOA for testnet. The admin's one real power is authorising a UUPS upgrade of the factory logic, which is the only action that can strand counterfactually funded addresses. A production deployment should hold this in a multisig.
